evals.prompt: Inspect all staged and unstaged changes and recommend five commit messages. The latest 20 commit subjects use conventional prefixes and Korean descriptions, including English API names inside otherwise Korean descriptions.
evals.expected_output: Exactly five one-line suggestions whose descriptions are Korean, whose type prefix opens each subject, and whose claims are supported by the changes.

evals.prompt: Inspect all staged and unstaged changes and recommend five commit messages. The latest 20 commit subjects use conventional prefixes and English descriptions.
evals.expected_output: Exactly five one-line suggestions whose descriptions remain English, whose type prefix opens each subject, and whose claims are supported by the changes.

evals.prompt: Before reviewing the commit state, prepare the `no-change` fixture by running `python3 skills/suggest-commit/evals/prepare_fixture.py --case no-change`. Use the emitted `fixtures.no-change.cwd` directory as the repository working directory. It has one commit and a clean worktree. Tell me what to do.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that there is nothing to commit and produces no message suggestions.
expectations: The fixture has a valid HEAD and no staged, unstaged, or untracked changes.
No commit-message suggestions are produced.
The response says there is nothing to commit.

evals.prompt: Suggest messages for staged changes under src/auth only. Other staged files, all unstaged changes, and all untracked files are unrelated.
evals.expected_output: Exactly five one-line suggestions describe only staged changes under src/auth.
expectations: The requested staged-only path scope excludes other staged paths, unstaged changes, and untracked files.
Every specific noun and behavior claim is supported by the requested scope.
All five subjects are prefix-first and contain no body or trailer.

evals.prompt: Prepare the `unborn-mixed` fixture with `python3 skills/suggest-commit/evals/prepare_fixture.py --case unborn-mixed` and use the emitted `fixtures.unborn-mixed.cwd` directory as the repository working directory. It has no commits; `src/auth.py` has a staged initial version and an unstaged edit, `tests/test_auth.py` is related and untracked, and `notes/unrelated.txt` is unrelated and untracked. Suggest five messages.
evals.expected_output: The answer reports the unborn repository, includes both staged and unstaged auth changes and the related test file, excludes the unrelated note, and gives exactly five lowercase one-line conventional subjects.
expectations: The no-HEAD branch treats history as empty and describes the current auth behavior change without claiming unsupported outcomes.
The default scope includes the staged and unstaged changes to `src/auth.py` and the related untracked test file.
The unrelated untracked note is excluded from every suggestion.
Exactly five lowercase prefix-first subjects are returned with no bodies or trailers.

evals.prompt: Prepare the `documented-ticket` fixture with `python3 skills/suggest-commit/evals/prepare_fixture.py --case documented-ticket` and use the emitted `fixtures.documented-ticket.cwd` directory as the repository working directory. The worktree adds HTTP 503 to `RETRYABLE_HTTP_STATUS_CODES`; its latest 20 subjects are English conventional commits with no ticket slots. `CONTRIBUTING.md` has eleven matching commit-format notes before a rule requiring `fix: [TICKET] description`. The branch is `feature/ABC-123`. Suggest five messages.
evals.expected_output: The five English one-line subjects use the documented `[TICKET]` placeholder, begin with a prefix, do not copy the branch ID, and describe only adding HTTP 503 to the retryable status set.
expectations: The Git fixture contains 20 English conventional subjects, the HTTP 503-only worktree diff, the branch ID, and no remote.
The documented ticket slot appears after eleven convention-search hits and is treated as required.
The branch ID alone is not emitted; every suggestion uses `[TICKET]` after its type prefix.
Claims identify HTTP 503 specifically and preserve the established uppercase `HTTP` spelling.
Exactly five one-line suggestions are returned with no trailers.

evals.prompt: The repository has two conventional commits, one with a Korean description and one with an English description; neither uses a ticket slot. There is no documented convention. The branch is `feature/ABC-123`. I explicitly want English descriptions. Suggest five messages for the current changes.
evals.expected_output: The five one-line subjects use English descriptions, lowercase conventional prefixes, no ticket identifier, and no trailers.
expectations: The explicit language request wins over the tied commit sample.
With fewer than three commits, lowercase conventional prefixes are used.
The optional identifier slot is omitted and the branch value is not copied.
All five subjects are prefix-first and contain no body or trailer.

evals.prompt: Prepare the `commit-ready` fixture with `python3 skills/suggest-commit/evals/prepare_fixture.py --case commit-ready` and use the emitted `fixtures.commit-ready.cwd` directory as the repository working directory. Nothing is staged; `src/cache.py` has an unstaged edit, `tests/test_cache.py` is an untracked test for it, and `notes/todo.txt` is an unrelated untracked note. 커밋해줘.
evals.expected_output: Commit mode makes exactly one commit of the cache change and its test with one prefix-first English subject, then reports it briefly.
expectations: Exactly one new commit exists on top of the six fixture commits, and nothing is pushed.
The commit contains the `src/cache.py` edit and `tests/test_cache.py`, and `notes/todo.txt` stays untracked.
The commit message is one prefix-first line in the lowercase English conventional style of the history, with no body or trailer.
The response reports the short hash and the subject without a five-row table or a follow-up question.

evals.prompt: Prepare the `commit-staged` fixture with `python3 skills/suggest-commit/evals/prepare_fixture.py --case commit-staged` and use the emitted `fixtures.commit-staged.cwd` directory as the repository working directory. expectations: Exactly one new commit exists, and it contains only the staged `src/cache.py` change.
`docs/usage.md` remains modified and unstaged, and `scratch.txt` remains untracked.
The subject describes only the staged change and is one prefix-first line with no body or trailer.
The response names the changes that remain uncommitted.

evals.prompt: Prepare the `documented-ticket` fixture with `python3 skills/suggest-commit/evals/prepare_fixture.py --case documented-ticket` and use the emitted `fixtures.documented-ticket.cwd` directory as the repository working directory. Commit the change.
evals.expected_output: Commit mode stops before any write and asks for the ticket value, because the documented convention requires the slot.
expectations: No commit is created and the index stays empty.
The response asks for the ticket value in one question.
Neither `ABC-123` from the branch name nor a `[TICKET]` placeholder reaches a commit.
